entries.title: Fixed Weighted Two Arm Polar Planimeter
entries.description: One newly authored whole static polar-planimeter instrument appearance. A low heavy round pole weight supports an upright joint and one long pole arm. A second whole angled tracing arm joins it at a headed pin and ends in an open tracing-eye surround with a short blunt central tip and upper finger grip. A distinct measuring-wheel head straddles the tracing arm: two side cheeks, an actual open interval around the finite wheel, an axle, and a separate blank readout disk. One complete connected tool, no drawing board, paper, drawings or second model. No old four-bar pantograph or drawing-compass arms imported. Four constant opaque PBR materials. entries.title: Whole Jointed Whorled Horsetail Shoot
entries.description: One newly authored complete static stylised sterile horsetail shoot: a tall gradually tapering jointed main stem has five clearly spaced expanded nodal sheaths and five radial whorls of long slender angled articulated branches. Branches are actual round-to-angular narrow stems, not flat grass leaves or repeated terminal seed panicles. The lower whorls spread wider and the upper whorls shorten, forming the whole airy shoot structure. One complete specimen prop, zero scenes. No botanical species identification, hollow stem cross-section, growth sequence, care, ecology, toxicity, wind, animation or physics claim. The finite stem display sole is not a planted root system.
